description: This file defines an abstract class 'SearchEngine' within the 'SuiteCRM\Search' namespace. The class provides an interface and utility methods for implementing various search engines in SuiteCRM, including methods for performing searches, displaying search forms, displaying search results, and validating queries. The class interacts with external controller classes and exceptions related to search functionality.

classes.name: SearchEngine
classes.description: An abstract class serving as an interface and utility provider for search engine implementations, handling search execution, display, and validation.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Abstract method to perform a search using a SearchQuery object, returning SearchResults.

methods.name: searchAndDisplay
methods.description: Performs a search and displays the results and the search form if the query is not empty.

methods.name: displayForm
methods.description: Displays the search form interface using SearchFormController.

methods.name: validateQuery
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes the SearchQuery object; trims whitespace by default, throws exception if invalid.
